summary: Optional TypeScript collection-stream connection and command-send callbacks

replay.detail: No replay behavior or stored state changes.

schema.detail: No database schema or migration changes.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or coordinated member upgrade changes.

compatibility.detail: Adds optional onOpen and onCommandSent callbacks to TypeScript CollectionStreamOptions. Existing callers remain unchanged; callbacks report the WebSocket open event and subscribe or unsubscribe commands after socket.send, including queued commands. No wire protocol or server capability changes.

downtime.detail: No additional service interruption or restart required.

manual.detail: No installation changes required. Clients may opt into the callbacks to report actual connection and command-send state.

recovery.detail: No stored-state or runtime recovery changes; the additive client API introduces no migration.
